messages:
alex: prepping a phased geo-buckets rollout for inference v2.3 today 18:00 PT — who's owning smoke and rollback?
maya-ops: I can own smoke checks and post dash snaps. will run the sample QA and latency suite.
sam-sre: I'll own rollback readiness and watch error budget, have rollback script staged.
tracy-platform: tagging infra owners: we're using geo-buckets (us-west, eu-central, ap-southeast) — prefer start in us-west only.
deploy-bot: [BOT] release v2.3 created, CI: green, reserved deploy window 18:00 PT :rocket:
alex: plan: 18:00 push image -> 18:05 shift 0.5% to us-west -> ramp to 5% over 20m -> hold 30m -> 25% next hour -> continue to 100% if stable.
alex: rollout policy: if p95 > 350ms or errors > 0.2% hold/rollback. embeddings regression alert trip -> immediate pause.
maya-ops: smoke checklist (I'll run):
```
- curl https://prod-infer.example.com/health -> 200
- run smoke-run.sh --bucket=us-west --qps=50 (sample prompts)
- p95 latency < 300ms
- error rate < 0.1% (5m window)
- run embeddings QA against golden set (10 samples)
```
maya-ops: I'll post smoke logs to this thread when done.
deploy-bot: [BOT] deploy job queued by alex at 18:00 PT
maya-ops: smoke-run.sh output (18:06): us-west smoke OK. p95=210ms, errors=0.02%, embeddings sample OK :thumbsup:
sam-sre: observing spike at 18:08 — brief 502s to frontend behind us-west; error spike peaked 0.6% for 2m. I executed quick rollback from 5% -> 1% for us-west and opened a ticket to investigate.
alex: good call to drop back. hold further ramps until we have 30m stable after rollback. status of CPU/GPU queues?
tracy-platform: infra note: queue backlog spiked because of KV-cache pressure on the new variant; autoscaler triggered extra nodes but with 90s delay. adding hotfix to warm caches on startup.
maya-ops: re-ran smoke at 18:20 after rollback fix: p95=220ms, errors=0.03%, embeddings OK. posting logs: https://internal/links/roll-logs (internal).
sam-sre: continuing to monitor; if errors creep above 0.2% for 5m I'll trigger full rollback via `./scripts/rollback-buckets --to 0.0`.
alex: agreed. once we have 30m green from 18:20 -> target next ramp at 18:50 to 25% for us-west, then mirror to eu-central after that. ap-southeast last.
tracy-platform: note: eu-central will use smaller increment steps because of different latency profiles (0.5% -> 3% -> 10%).
maya-ops: added temporary alert: embeddings-regression > 0.5 -> page on-call. added p95 increase > +40% -> slack #eng-oncall.
alex: final signoff checklist before continuing: @maya-ops smoke green, @sam-sre rollback tested, @tracy-platform infra warmup in place.
maya-ops: signed — smoke green.
sam-sre: signed — rollback tested and scripted.
tracy-platform: signed — infra warmers deployed.
alex: proceeding with scheduled ramp at 18:50 if no regressions. I'm heading into a meeting; ping me for manual override.
deploy-bot: [BOT] traffic shift executed: us-west -> 5% at 18:05 by alex (initial), reduced to 1% at 18:09 by sam-sre, resumed 5% at 18:25 by maya-ops.
maya-ops: posting short summary after 2h and final ramp decisions.
sam-sre: will escalate to incident if >0.2% errors sustained for 10m.
alex: thanks all — excellent run. will follow up with retrospective notes and any rollout tweaks.
